patterns.note: Full-bleed, high-contrast sections with content often presented in a split-screen or asymmetrical arrangement.
Juxtaposition of highly decorative, often distorted display typefaces with clean, minimalist sans-serifs for functional and descriptive text.
A stark black and white palette forms the base, accented by vibrant RGB chromatic aberration effects on animated elements.
Scroll-triggered WebGL animations apply liquid-like distortion and glitch effects to text and abstract graphic elements as they enter the viewport.
Sections are full-viewport height, transitioning with dynamic, motion-driven reveals rather than static breaks.

technique_notes: The site leverages WebGL (likely Three.js) to implement sophisticated scroll-triggered animations. Text and graphic elements are revealed with a distinctive liquid or glitch distortion effect that animates as they scroll into view, creating a dynamic, almost melting appearance. Abstract lines also feature a chromatic aberration effect, enhancing the digital art aesthetic.

design_tokens.type_scale: Features an extreme typographic hierarchy, contrasting oversized, highly decorative display fonts (up to 5x body text size) with small, uppercase sans-serifs for labels and functional text.
design_tokens.spacing: airy (generous use of negative space, particularly in hero sections and between major content blocks, creating a sparse and deliberate composition)

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold and experimental use of WebGL-driven, scroll-triggered text and graphic distortions. This creates a unique, almost avant-garde digital art experience that transcends typical portfolio aesthetics, making the content itself a dynamic, interactive element.
